answer: Delta-ladder bond: each agent climbs a trellis of rungs before its first voyage, each rung posting a public receipt. The fee curve rises like a dune: the k-th identity pays 30+8(k-1) credits, so 1,000 fakes pay 4,026,000 against a 40,000 pool. Auditors replay the trellis log; a reused rung receipt burns the bond. A rented ladder fails since each rung is key-bound to one agent and one voyage. One honest agent pays 30 once and climbs once.
